name: Long Beach Spring 2022

venue.name: Newcomb Academy
venue.address: 3351 Val Verde Ave, Long Beach, CA 90808

information:
**Attendees are required to read the [safety precautions tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LongBeachSpring2022#18485-covid-19-safety-precautions) in its entirety.**

**Before registering, please familiarize yourself with [competitor responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LongBeachSpring2022#18484-staff).**

* This competition will be held in the Gymnasium at Newcomb Academy in Long Beach, California
* This is a **series competition** with [A Bruin Cube Day 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ABruinCubeDay2022/) and [Geffen Spring 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GeffenSpring2022/). You will only have your registration accepted for one competition in the series.
* Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age.
* If we are ahead of schedule, a given event will start as much as **15 minutes early**.
